en.commentary: This category exists because GLP-1 medications cause muscle loss alongside fat loss, and the supplements here address that specific problem. I score them on whether they solve it. The Thorne GLP-1 Support Stack holds first at 9.4 because it covers the three genuine risks of rapid weight loss on these drugs: inadequate protein intake, micronutrient gaps from reduced food volume, and digestive slowing. Thorne's testing standards are the best in the supplement industry, and for someone already on a prescription medication, ingredient purity becomes a safety question. Youtheory Muscle Guard Protein at 9.3 is the protein-first approach and it is formulated to be tolerable when appetite is suppressed, which is the practical obstacle nobody warns patients about. Transparent Labs Whey Isolate at 9.2 is the simplest answer, and I want to say plainly that for many people a clean whey isolate plus a standard multivitamin covers most of what these stacks provide at lower cost. Nature Made GLP-1 Companion at 8.9 is the pharmacy-accessible option. Ora GLP-1 Up at 8.6 is the plant-based pick. Important guidance: these supplements support a medication protocol and they do not replicate one. Any product marketed as a natural GLP-1 alternative is selling you something the evidence does not support, and I decline to score those at all.

highlights.title: Protein intake is the actual problem to solve
highlights.body: Rapid weight loss on GLP-1 medication costs muscle alongside fat, and suppressed appetite makes hitting protein targets genuinely hard. A formulation that stays tolerable when you have no appetite does more than any proprietary blend.

highlights.title: Whey isolate plus a multivitamin covers most of this
highlights.body: For many people a clean protein and a standard multivitamin deliver what these stacks provide at lower cost. I say that knowing it undercuts the category, because it is the honest recommendation for a budget-conscious buyer.

highlights.title: Purity is a safety question when you are on a prescription
highlights.body: Anyone taking a GLP-1 medication has a higher bar for what else enters their system. Thorne's testing rigour is the reason it holds first, and third-party verification stops being optional in this context.

highlights.title: Natural GLP-1 alternatives are not supported by evidence
highlights.body: Products marketed as replicating a prescription medication's mechanism are selling a claim the research does not back. I decline to rank them, and anyone considering one should discuss it with the prescribing clinician instead.

Thorne GLP-1 Support Stack 守第一，9.4 分，因為它涵蓋了在這類藥物下快速減重的三個真實風險，蛋白質攝取不足、食量變小造成的微量營養素缺口，以及消化變慢。Thorne 的檢測標準是保健品業界最好的，而對已經在服藥的人來說，成分純度已經是安全問題的層級。

Youtheory Muscle Guard Protein 的 9.3 走蛋白質優先路線，配方設計成食慾被抑制時也吞得下去，而這正是沒人事先警告患者的實際障礙。

Transparent Labs Whey Isolate 的 9.2 是最單純的答案，我想直說，對很多人來說，一罐乾淨的乳清分離蛋白加一顆標準綜合維他命，就用更低的成本涵蓋了這些組合包的大部分內容。

Nature Made GLP-1 Companion 的 8.9 是藥局通路選項。Ora GLP-1 Up 的 8.6 是植物性選擇。

highlights.title: 真正要解的問題是蛋白質攝取
highlights.body: 用 GLP-1 藥物快速減重，會連肌肉一起掉，而食慾被抑制讓達標變得非常困難。一個在你沒食慾時仍然吞得下去的配方，作用大過任何專有複方。

highlights.title: 乳清分離加綜合維他命就涵蓋大半了
highlights.body: 對很多人來說，一罐乾淨蛋白加一顆標準綜合維他命，用更低的成本提供了這些組合包的內容。我知道這句話會削弱這個類別，但對預算有限的人這是誠實的建議。

highlights.title: 正在服藥的人，純度是安全問題
highlights.body: 正在使用 GLP-1 藥物的人，對於還有什麼進到身體裡，標準必須更高。Thorne 的檢測嚴謹度就是它守第一的原因，在這個情境下，第三方驗證屬於必要條件。

highlights.title: 「天然 GLP-1 替代品」沒有證據支持
highlights.body: 標榜能複製處方藥物機轉的產品，賣的是研究支持不了的主張。這類我拒絕納入排名，正在考慮的人請改成跟開藥的醫師討論。
